The single paragraph has awkward collocations: a meeting scheduled without enough time to manage it, and fit around the other person. Express overcommitting to a date and failing to make time despite promising to accommodate them in ordinary English.
In the breakup paragraph, start with a relaxed arrangement is a literal and vague rendering of 편한 약속. Refer plainly to arranging a casual meeting.
The conversation keeps insisting has the wrong acting subject. One or both people insist that only one person must change; the conversation itself does not.

Breakup closing: step away for a while from the reply you have been waiting for is not a natural object for step away. State taking a break from waiting/checking for that reply, retaining the KO sense.
Single second sentence: Once a wish to meet is confirmed is impersonal and stiff compared with the everyday source. Name the person wanting to meet rather than a confirmed wish.

Couple: announce a marriage you have not decided on is not the usual way to describe declaring marriage plans in anger. Use natural phrasing for declaring plans to marry or break up before deciding, with the same KO scope.
Last sentence has mismatched grammar: check whether ... rather than on what. Use parallel verb/complement construction when contrasting the changed breakup problem with promised material rewards.

Single opening: learning together or sharing an interest could introduce someone new is missing the recipient of introduce. Use an ordinary construction for meeting a new person through learning/common interests.
Couple: interference with messages sounds like interfering with communications technically. Say plainly interfering in who the partner contacts/how they spend, preserving the source control meaning.

Single advertises their advantages reads like a product listing; couple claiming all the say is not an ordinary idiom. Use natural descriptions of boasting about good prospects/material advantages and taking all decision-making control.

Second paragraph: how much is included is unclear after discussing a payment amount. KO specifies what work and how far the work goes, so make scope of work explicit rather than implying another money amount.
Someone joining an expense is not an ordinary collocation. Describe someone sharing a cost the user previously paid alone.
Opening preserve your money calmly is a literal awkward verb/adverb combination. Express keeping finances/money steady during a day without big income or spending in ordinary English.

Opening resolved again implies the same matter was already resolved once. KO means a money matter with no news can make progress/be settled now; retain renewed opportunity without asserting a previous resolution.
A welcome-looking offer is an unnatural compound. Use ordinary wording for an offer that initially seems welcome/promising.
Final reveal a useful contribution is vague and impersonal for money turning out to help. Make clear that checking actual payment may show the offer is financially useful.
Last before promising on your own lacks a natural object/complement. Clarify committing to the larger expense without discussing it.
The other persons initial kindness can imply they were only nice at first. KO means they offer goodwill/help first. Use a clear offer-of-help action without adding a later change in attitude.
Opening keep whats worthwhile is vague and not naturally financial. Clearly identify retaining the financial benefit/fair share while settling a money matter calmly.
An emotional transaction is an unnatural collocation. Describe a financial decision/deal driven by emotion in ordinary words.
Closing spend living costs is not idiomatic and blurs the meaning. KO warns against using even money needed for daily living in reliance on income not yet received. Name the money for living costs.
Final sharply increase the next costs is not ordinary wording. Describe increasing subsequent/future spending before receipt of payment plainly.
People offer better terms against each other has an awkward verb/preposition link. Say they compete to offer better terms without adding new scope.

Last sentence turns KO rather than spending to show off into buy necessities BEFORE spending to show off, which can endorse doing the show-off spending afterwards. Preserve the alternative/caution instead of a sequence.
Several promised payments falling together lacks the normal due-date expression and is unclear. Make it plain that several payments become due at once.

Several collocations in this bundle are literal: matching pay, bigger work, judging within your experience, Promise confidently without object. Rework into ordinary English for reward proportional to responsibility, a larger job/undertaking, decisions informed by experience, and commitments within affordable costs.
Third sentence A money issue ... is worth discussing terms for compromise has a tangled subject/complement. State discussing compromise terms for a long-running money issue plainly.
A reducible burden untouched is an unnatural abstract noun/adjective construction. State that giving up before checking may leave costs unchanged even though they could be reduced.
A money problem that looked overwhelming alone leaves alone awkwardly attached. Make clear it seemed overwhelming when the person faced it alone.
Comparing an item lacks what is being compared in ordinary shopping English. Clarify comparing prices/options for the purchase, retaining the cheaper-item outcome.
A favourable-looking transaction is a stiff compound; use ordinary phrasing for a deal that appears favourable.
Past money and effort fails to identify money already put into the work/deal. Name prior money spent/invested rather than past money.
On-time money is an invented compound; make the payment arriving on time the subject. Corresponding pay should also read plainly.
Slow incoming money could make finances frustrating is a literal awkward first sentence. State how delayed/slow payments make the financial situation difficult or frustrating for the person.
Plenty for everyday spending could put you at ease leaves the opening subject overly compressed. Name having enough money for daily spending plainly.
Long-practised work is not the ordinary way to describe work someone has done for a long time; avoid the unnatural compound.
Draw a clear limit at transactions is the wrong collocation for drawing a line/refusing unaffordable deals.
Work paragraph: shared intentions with a collaborator sounds translated and abstract; express agreeing with a colleague in ordinary English while retaining the shared-goal meaning.
First sentence is difficult to parse because it nests ability and a comparison to amount studied. State the disappointing gap between studying and solving questions directly in natural English.
Nerves may not stop you from calmly showing is an indirect negative opening. State directly that the reader can perform calmly despite nerves, preserving the positive reading.

Last sentence says increase the amount without saying the amount of what; the surrounding care/approach nouns do not supply a countable object. Express the warning against doing more than recommended naturally without inventing a medication or dose.

Care repeats four times and Continue any care you have followed sounds institutional/translated. Use natural routine/guidance wording while keeping professional advice and not changing/combining approaches alone.
Strength could gradually return to a tired body sounds impersonal and translated. Address the reader directly for the first recovery judgment, preserving gradual recovery.
Increase exercise or care all at once is an unnatural coordination: care has no clear amount. Keep the original warning against abruptly increasing exercise or the health routine in ordinary English.
Time spent resting enough is not a natural English noun phrase. Express that taking enough time to rest is not wasted, without changing the following symptom/medical-care condition.

Full mixed-suits comparison: KO gives cancellation OR unavailable help; JA 取り消され、助けも得られない reads as both occurring together. Retain alternative possibilities. The standalone pause 失望を助けようとする人にぶつける also has an ambiguous relative-clause boundary; make clear it means directing disappointment at a person trying to help.

Final 食事も休みも、体に負担のない量を保ちましょう is a literal, vague quantity construction, especially 休みの量を保つ. Express keeping sufficient, comfortable meals and rest naturally while preserving KO meaning and avoiding a new diet prescription.
